name: Vrock
summary: A vulture-like demon that shreds foes, releases spores, and screeches.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vrock makes two Shred attacks.

actions.name: Spores

save.targets: each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock

actions.onFailure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While Poisoned, the target takes {dmg:1d10:poison} at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of Holy Water on the target ends the effect early.

actions.name: Stunning Screech

save.targets: each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically)

actions.onFailure: and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the vrock's next turn.
